verdict.rationale: Any product with a public web presence could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to Instinct. The probe found only a robots.txt allowing AI crawlers and a sitemap listing just the homepage. There is no llms.txt, docs site or developer pages, and a permissive robots.txt is an adjacent control, not agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
